name: greater_
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::greater_.Tensor(Tensor(a!) self, Tensor other) -> Tensor(a!). The tests also cover aten::greater_.Scalar. Both overloads compare elementwise, write zero-or-one results into self using self's dtype, and return the same Tensor object and storage. Coverage includes equal-shape and broadcast Tensor operands, Scalar operands, zero-sized and noncontiguous inputs, float64 precision, other-input non-mutation, output metadata, and rejection of non-broadcastable shapes.
